correction: Replace the invalid single-cylinder/secant argument by a compact tube, two-sided first-exit estimates and uniform variational remainder/continuity estimates, preserving the full original Statement and common interval.

alert.finding: Proof 1.1 asserts that every nearby solution graph lies in 'one compact cylinder K ⊆ D'; Proof 2.1 then evaluates DxF on the straight secant between two nearby trajectories and invokes uniform continuity on K. An arbitrary open ODE domain need not contain a single product cylinder covering the whole trajectory, and containment of both trajectories in a compact set alone does not put their secants in it. A compact neighborhood of the base graph with a uniform interior margin, followed by sufficiently small initial perturbations, supplies the needed argument.

The numbered proof steps end their tagged paragraphs before continuing the same arguments in separate untagged paragraphs and displays. For example, Proof 1.1 ends '[F1, L1, L2]' before the displayed variational equation and the paragraph beginning 'whose existence on I is given by [L2]'. Proofs 2.1–4.1 have the same structure. This violates the requirement that each complete step occupy one paragraph and end with its justification tags.
